scope: Reviewed Phase 2 decimal, percent, cardinal, and ordinal profiles only

profiles.en: Latin digits; comma grouping; period decimal; English cardinal and ordinal rules
profiles.fr: Latin digits; narrow no-break-space grouping; comma decimal; French cardinal rules
profiles.ru: Latin digits; no-break-space grouping; comma decimal; Russian cardinal rules
profiles.ar: Arabic-Indic digits and separators; Arabic cardinal rules
profiles.zh: Latin digits; comma grouping; period decimal; other-only cardinal and ordinal rules

notes: Runtime tables are generated as explicit code in PinnedLocaleData.cs.
No CLDR data is downloaded during configure, build, or execution.
Production locale enablement still requires native-speaker and font-coverage review.
